en.headline: sogeisetsu: 33 commits on 2026-10-23, mostly sopen-translate fixes
en.summary: On 2026-10-23, `sogeisetsu` made **33 own commits** across three repositories, with no pull requests, issues, reviews, releases, or discussions recorded. Most of the work landed in `sogeisetsu/sopen-translate` with 30 commits: documentation updates charting a GitHub-renderable MT/LLM/DeepL path diagram, viewport scroll-to-bottom coverage, an F5 term-retention sample, and a four-page MT vs MT+review A/B result; CSS toast selectors scoped under the overlay host; provider fixes for own-property protocol id lookup and a new keyless Google web endpoint preset marked unverified; and review changes to expose review flags, validate index/corrected review responses, and cap the review budget per page rather than per batch. In `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu` there were 2 own commits switching the `/oc` and diagnostic model from longcat to `opencode-go/deepseek-v4.1-flash` and retiring the minimax and longcat free legs in favor of a deepseek → sensenova chain, plus 25 automated commits by `github-actions[bot]`. A single commit in `sogeisetsu/opencode-skill-management` carried the `1.0.0` version bump. No collection section hit its cap, so the day's record is complete.

zh.headline: sogeisetsu 2026-10-23 提交 33 次，主要修 sopen-translate
zh.summary: 2026-10-23，`sogeisetsu` 在三个仓库共完成 **33 次本人提交**，当天没有 pull request、issue、review、release 或 discussion 记录。主要工作集中在 `sogeisetsu/sopen-translate`，共 30 次提交：文档方面补充了可在 GitHub 渲染的 MT/LLM/DeepL 路径图、视口滚动到底部覆盖情况、F5 术语保留样例结果，以及四页 MT 与 MT+review 的 A/B 结果；CSS 方面把 toast 选择器限定在 overlay 宿主之下；provider 方面修复协议 id 的自有属性查找，并新增无需密钥的 Google 网页端点作为未验证预设；review 方面暴露 review 标记、校验 index/corrected 两种 review 响应逐项内容，并把 review 预算改为按页面而非按批次限制。`sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu` 有 2 次本人提交，把 `/oc` 与诊断所用模型从 longcat 换成 `opencode-go/deepseek-v4.1-flash`，并下线 minimax 与 longcat 两条免费腿，链变为 deepseek → sensenova；另有 25 次由 `github-actions[bot]` 自动提交。`sogeisetsu/opencode-skill-management` 的 1 次提交用于 `1.0.0` 版本号更新。各采集分区均未触及上限，当天记录完整。
